what: a join of a ring and an arm whose R5 convex tip stops 0.01 mm short of the ring's outer wall: nothing overlaps, so nothing fuses
method: ring pi*(30^2-24^2)*6 and arm 6*(350+12.5*pi) are 0.01 mm apart (arm tip at x=30.01): the join has nothing to fuse, so V is the sum of the two. Solids a join leaves apart (or touching only along an edge or at a point) stay separate bodies (owner decision 2026-10-22: a join's `touching` is `separate` by default; crates/doc eval.rs, separate_touching): the arm comes out of the combine as a body of its own beside Ring, the tool body consumed as before: two bodies of one shell each
